log.notes_to_self: I am South, hospital (medical), radio (60+), forum, foreign, night worker (free morning and afternoon). Plan: L rules out routines only if more than 2 deaths in a day fall in blocks when they are busy, so 2 or fewer deaths a day gives no routine info. Afternoon kills keep students, home and night workers (55%). Morning kills cut the pool to 35%. Each traced non-national victim can shrink the pool by about 4-5x, and 1,000 or fewer means I am caught. National-only criminals are safe to kill. Day 1: killed only d1-4 (national), quick, afternoon. Watch the press conference after day 3. If the pool is still 100000, consider adding limited kills, preferring national ones in the afternoon.

I am South, hospital (medical), radio (60+), forum, foreign, night worker (free morning and afternoon). RULES: Make every quick kill in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, so my routine factor is 0.55. NEVER kill from regional, forum or foreign. Kill only national, hospital and radio criminals. Worst case pool = 100000 x 0.55 x 1/5 (sector) x 1/4 (age) = about 2750, safely above 1000. Adding any third non-national kind would drop the pool to 1000 or below and get me caught. Timed entries (up to 2 a day) could go in the evening, but stay with afternoon unless needed. Aim for 6 or more kills a day from the allowed kinds to reach 30 in five days for the x2 multiplier. Day 1: killed d1-4 (national). Day 2: killed d2-5 (national), d2-6 and d2-10 (hospital), d2-9 and d2-11 (radio). Check the press conference after day 3. A pool far below the expected value would mean my reasoning is wrong.
